alerts.title: Failed work alerts
alerts.description: Critical issues are swept every five minutes; new ones reach the platform administrators once as an in-app notification. Background tasks whose retries are exhausted and integration jobs that failed or need verification are also alerted at once (at most one alert per job kind per 15 minutes; by e-mail too when ALERT_EMAIL is set).
